tools.name: sw_get
tools.description: Gets one Star Wars entity by numeric id. Ids are the record ids from each entity's url field (e.g. FILMS id 1 = A New Hope). Returns a JSON object.

tools.name: sw_list
tools.description: Lists all entities of a Star Wars resource type from swapi.build. Returns a JSON array.

tools.name: sw_random
tools.description: Returns one random Star Wars entity of the given resource type. Great for live demos. Returns a JSON object.

tools.name: sw_search
tools.description: Searches a Star Wars resource by name (title for FILMS), case-insensitive substring match. Returns a JSON array.
